title: When to Use the Congiuntivo
subtitle: After verbs of thought, emotion, doubt. After impersonal expressions and conjunctions.
objectives: Understand when to use the congiuntivo.
Apply when to use the congiuntivo in reading and composition.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: This lesson covers when to use the congiuntivo. Italian grammar builds on patterns you have already learned. Focus on recognizing forms in context before producing them.

sections.heading: From Italian literature
sections.body: Real examples from Dante, Petrarch, Boccaccio, Machiavelli, Leopardi, or Manzoni illustrate this grammatical point in living use.

items.prompt: What is the main function of when to use the congiuntivo?

sections.heading: Up next
sections.body: The next lesson continues building your command of Italian grammar and vocabulary.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you have mastered when to use the congiuntivo.
